scope.purpose: Independent source review of diagnostic-only guest visibility census runner changes

confirmed: Each observation carries a bounded eight-level structural DOM path, safe role/tag, region, explicit structural/outside-panel flags, and either a matched literal source attribute or a redaction/unlabeled marker. Runtime element and label text cannot promote a name, including exact text collisions.

About diagnostics distinguish click-stage failure from content inspection failure, categorize timeout/runtime/transport cases, and make at most one read-only inspection retry. A failed first inspection remains incomplete even if retry returns data.

Blocked requests remain aborted for non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS HTTP(S) methods. Diagnostic output omits query strings and request bodies; known RPC paths are restricted to source-discovered literal RPC names and unknown paths are redacted. Fixed sidepanel/extension_worker target labels identify the observation boundary.

Known RPC read/write classifications align with the inspected source callsites: knob_snapshot, knob_resolve, and mbr_for_user are reads; log_client_error and set_last_active_organization are writes. Unmapped names retain unclassified semantics.
About diagnostics preserve fixed pointer-driver failure codes while dropping the error message and attached private detail.
unsupported_claims: The patch does not establish product behavior or a product defect verdict.
The patch does not by itself explain why the original About inspection failed; it adds diagnostics for a future run.

forcing_evidence: The identity test fails when the diagnostic identity field is renamed away, rejects a constant observation result against distinct expected identities, and redacts exact text collisions from visible text and label contents.
The About test distinguishes runtime failure from click timeout and a pointer-specific failure code, asserts exact click/read counts, and proves a successful retry cannot erase the first failure.

The blocked-RPC test checks read/write/unknown classifications and verifies secret-like query/body material is absent from serialized diagnostics. Existing mutationGuard coverage still asserts Fetch.failRequest for POST and continuation for GET.

verdict_b.evidence: The RPC test calls the diagnostic helper directly; interception behavior is separately covered by the existing mutationGuard test.

open_items: No full hosted census was run as part of this source review; no runtime observation or product behavior claim is made.
